title: The Inquisitor
text: An inquisitor of the Court stops the party in the road, his face hidden behind a mask of white porcelain while his guards spread out to block the way. One of you is a heretic, he says mildly, and he wants to know which. He has all day.

options.label: Point at a rival House and let the inquisitor take his heretic from them.

outcomes.text: He takes careful note in a little black book. Your rivals will not forget this.

options.label: The devout one recites the creed for him, word for word.

outcomes.text: They recite it without a single slip. He sounds disappointed as he waves you through.

options.label: Strike first; no masked man accuses your House of anything.

outcomes.text: His guards were hoping you would.
